name: Scatterbrain 便利贴工作坊
source: ClawHive-authored style card; no external vendor assets included.
pptFallback: 复杂 CSS 效果改为静态填充、渐变或烘焙背景，文字和形状保持原生

typography.title_stack: Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
typography.title_stack_ppt: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

behavior: 气质：随性、发散、工作坊感；视觉语汇：便利贴层叠、手写箭头、黑白底上单色标记；装饰：sticky notes, hand arrows and loose underlines；构图：associative grouping allowed; final claim must align cleanly
taboos: 避免看起来像未整理草稿
关键结论不能手写难辨
coverStructure: messy cluster resolves around one central question
sectionStructure: chapters pin a decision, then clean up the notes
titleTreatment: marker-like title with a tidy conclusion line
decorativeLanguage: sticky notes, hand arrows and loose underlines
bodyCompositionBias: associative grouping allowed; final claim must align cleanly
